summary.content:
Today's selection covers 68 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: All the news about Anthropic’s new AI fight with the White House
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: FBI: Fraudsters use couriers to steal money in crypto scams
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, Dark Reading, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 42 articles published in the last 24 hours
